9) 'Read the letter and match the paragraphs to the headings.' XAT (qo'lyozma): 'Dear Tina, 1 How are you? Remember I told you that we were going to China on holiday? Well, we had a lovely time. We were there for the Spring Festival, the oldest and most important festival in China, celebrating the New Year. 2 Before the festival, everyone cleaned their house, decorated the walls with pictures, and hung banners beside the front door for good luck. A lot of food was also prepared for the occasion. 3 On New Year's Eve, everyone made sure their house was brightly lit and everyone stayed up very late, eating a large family dinner and setting off firecrackers. You should try to go there for the Spring Festival next year. 5 Please write soon. exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form: -ing form, to-infinitive, or infinitive without to. (8 marks)
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri shaklga qo'ying: -ing shakli, to-infinitiv yoki 'to'siz infinitiv. (8 ball)
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR:
  1 playing (love + -ing)
  2 be (would + to'siz)
  3 to go (would like + to)
  4 laughing (couldn't help + -ing)
  5 to buy (remember = unutmaslik
    → to)
  6 to adopt (decide + to)
  7 tell (can + to'siz)
  8 to send (forget = qilishni
    unutmoq → to)


⚠ 'STREAMERS':

  = rangli qog'oz lentalar (bazm).


⚠ 'BALLOONS':

  = sharlar.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the letter. Dear Tina, ... Love, Jean
exercises.instructionUz: Xatni o'qing. Aziz Tina, ... Muhabbat bilan, Jean
exercises.explanationUz:
XAT TARJIMASI:

Aziz Tina,

1) Qalaysan? Xitoyga ta'tilga
borishimizni aytganimni eslaysanmi?
Xo'sh, ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik. Biz u
yerda Bahor festivali - Xitoydagi
Yangi yilni nishonlovchi eng qadimiy
va muhim festival paytida edik.

2) Festivaldan oldin hamma uyini
tozaladi, devorlarni rasmlar bilan
bezadi va omad uchun eshik oldiga
bayroqchalar osdi. Bayram uchun
ko'p ovqat ham tayyorlandi.

3) Yangi yil arafasida hamma uyi
yorug' yoritilganiga ishonch hosil
qildi va hamma juda kech uxladi -
katta oilaviy kechki ovqat yeb,
mushaklar otib. Ertasi kuni odamlar
qo'shnilar, qarindoshlar va
do'stlarnikiga borishdi va shirin va
sho'r ichli chuchvara yeyishdi. Bu
go'zal edi, chunki barcha uylar
rangli fonarlar bilan bezatilgan
edi.

4) Xitoyda bo'lish shunday ajoyib
vaqt edi. Biz chindan zavqlandik.
Kelasi yil Bahor festivaliga u yerga
borishga harakat qilishing kerak.

5) Iltimos, tez orada yoz.
Muhabbat bilan, Jean


⚠ 'THE SPRING FESTIVAL':

  = Bahor festivali (Xitoy Yangi
  yili).


⚠ 'A BANNER':

  = bayroqcha, shior.


⚠ 'FOR GOOD LUCK':

  = omad uchun.


⚠ 'THE OCCASION':

  = tadbir, bayram.


⚠ 'NEW YEAR'S EVE':

  = Yangi yil arafasi.


⚠ 'BRIGHTLY LIT':

  = yorug' yoritilgan.


⚠ 'FIRECRACKERS':

  = mushaklar (portlovchi).


⚠ 'DUMPLINGS':

  = chuchvara.


⚠ 'SAVOURY':

  = sho'r, ziravorli (shirin emas).


⚠ 'A FILLING':

  = ich (chuchvara ichi).


⚠ 'A LANTERN':

  = fonar.


⚠ 'TO ENJOY ONESELF':

  = zavqlanmoq.

points.en: Dear Tina, How are you? Remember I told you that we were going to China on holiday? Well, we had a lovely time. We were there for the Spring Festival, the oldest and most important festival in China, celebrating the New Year.
points.uz: Aziz Tina, Qalaysan? Xitoyga ta'tilga borishimizni aytganimni eslaysanmi? Xo'sh, ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik. Biz u yerda Bahor festivali - Xitoydagi Yangi yilni nishonlovchi eng qadimiy va muhim festival paytida edik.

points.en: Before the festival, everyone cleaned their house, decorated the walls with pictures, and hung banners beside the front door for good luck. A lot of food was also prepared for the occasion.
points.uz: Festivaldan oldin hamma uyini tozaladi, devorlarni rasmlar bilan bezadi va omad uchun eshik oldiga bayroqchalar osdi. Bayram uchun ko'p ovqat ham tayyorlandi.

points.en: On New Year's Eve, everyone made sure their house was brightly lit and everyone stayed up very late, eating a large family dinner and setting off firecrackers. The next day, people visited neighbours, relatives and friends and ate dumplings with sweet and savoury fillings. It was beautiful because all the houses were decorated with colourful lanterns.
points.uz: Yangi yil arafasida hamma uyi yorug' yoritilganiga ishonch hosil qildi va hamma juda kech uxladi - katta oilaviy kechki ovqat yeb, mushaklar otib. Ertasi kuni odamlar qo'shnilar, qarindoshlar va do'stlarnikiga borishdi va shirin va sho'r ichli chuchvara yeyishdi. Bu go'zal edi, chunki barcha uylar rangli fonarlar bilan bezatilgan edi.

points.en: It was such a wonderful time to be in China. We really enjoyed ourselves. You should try to go there for the Spring Festival next year.
points.uz: Xitoyda bo'lish shunday ajoyib vaqt edi. Biz chindan zavqlandik. Kelasi yil Bahor festivaliga u yerga borishga harakat qilishing kerak.
Iltimos, tez orada yoz. Muhabbat bilan, Jean

structure.modelEn: Before the festival, people decorated the old city with flags and lanterns, and craftsmen prepared their best carpets, silk and pottery for the exhibition.
structure.modelUz: Festivaldan oldin odamlar eski shaharni bayroq va fonarlar bilan bezadi, hunarmandlar esa ko'rgazma uchun eng yaxshi gilam, ipak va sopol buyumlarini tayyorladi.

structure.modelEn: It was a wonderful experience. We really enjoyed ourselves. You should come with me next year!

modelAnswers:
Dear Anna,

How are you? I've just come back from Bukhara, where I went for the Silk and Spices Festival. We had a fantastic time!

Before the festival, people decorated the old city with flags and lanterns, and craftsmen prepared their best carpets, silk and pottery for the exhibition.

During the festival, there were parades with traditional costumes, and musicians played all day. We watched a fashion show, tasted delicious plov and bought some beautiful silk scarves.

It was a wonderful experience. We really enjoyed ourselves. You should come with me next year!

Please write soon.
Love,
Dilnoza
modelAnswersUz:
Aziz Anna,

Qalaysan? Hozirgina Buxorodan qaytdim - u yerga Ipak va ziravorlar festivaliga borgan edim. Ajoyib vaqt o'tkazdik!

Festivaldan oldin odamlar eski shaharni bayroq va fonarlar bilan bezadi, hunarmandlar esa ko'rgazma uchun eng yaxshi gilam, ipak va sopol buyumlarini tayyorladi.

Festival davomida an'anaviy kiyimlar bilan paradlar bo'ldi, musiqachilar kun bo'yi chaldi. Biz moda namoyishini tomosha qildik, mazali palov tatib ko'rdik va chiroyli ipak sharflar sotib oldik.

Bu ajoyib tajriba edi. Biz chindan zavqlandik. Kelasi yil men bilan kelishing kerak!

Iltimos, tez orada yoz.
Muhabbat bilan,
Dilnoza
